sinks.name: createInspection
sinks.payload:
{
        inspection_type: type,
        process_step: type === "in_process" ? (processStep as never) : null,
        item_name: itemName.trim(),
        lot_no: lotNo.trim() || null,
        quantity: num(quantity),
        supplier_id: type === "incoming" ? supplierId || null : null,
        inspected_on: inspectedOn,
        method,
        inspection_level: (method === "total" ? "total" : level) as never,
        lot_size: num(lotSize),
        sample_size: num(sampleSize) ?? autoPlan?.sampleSize ?? null,
        aql: num(aql),
        accept_count: num(acceptCount) ?? autoPlan?.accept ?? null,
        reject_qty: num(rejectQty),
        temperature_c: num(temperature),
        humidity_pct: num(humidity),
        equipment_id: equipmentId || null,
        /* 저장 단추는 모든 항목을 고른 뒤에만 열린다(unjudged): 빈 판정은 없다 */
        items: items as InspectionItem[],
        // 완제품 = 포장 기록 / 공정 = 그 공정의 기록 (093 → 116)
        production_record_id:
          type === "final" || type === "in_process"
            ? productionRecordId || null
            : null,
        qc_chart_id: qcChartId || null,
        qc_process_step: qcChartId ? qcProcessStep || null : null,
        notes: notes.trim() || null,
      }

sinks.name: saveChecklist
sinks.payload:
{
        id,
        department_id: header.department_id || null,
        admin_department_id: header.admin_department_id || null,
        written_on: header.written_on,
        eval_subject: header.eval_subject.trim() || null,
        eval_on: header.eval_on || null,
        evaluator_id: header.evaluator_id || null,
        eval_type: header.eval_type,
        result: (result || null) as "conform" | "nonconform" | "re_eval" | null,
        notes: notes.trim() || null,
        grading_mode: mode,
        /* 평가 기준표 (431) */
        items_edited: reauthor,
        criteria_set_id: editItems ? sourceSetId : undefined,
        save_as_default: editItems && saveAsDefault,
        criteria_title: criteriaTitle.trim() || null,
        items: rows.map((x) => ({
          seq: x.seq,
          /* 항목표가 있는 구분에서는 서버가 이 둘을 무시한다 */
          category: x.category.trim(),
          label: x.label.trim(),
          score: x.score,
          verdict: (x.verdict || null) as
            | "conform"
            | "minor"
            | "nonconform"
            | null,
          note: x.note.trim() || null,
          is_critical: x.isCritical,
        })),
      }

sinks.name: saveProductBarcode
sinks.payload:
{
        id: edit?.id,
        product_name: productName.trim(),
        model_name: modelName.trim() || null,
        spec: specFromItem || spec.trim() || null,
        barcode: barcode.trim(),
        barcode_type: barcodeType as never,
        /*
         * 화면에 칸이 없는 값은 **원래 값을 그대로 돌려보낸다.** null 로 보내면
         * 수정 한 번에 조용히 지워진다. 화면에 안 보이니 지워진 줄도 모른다.
         */
        project_id: edit?.project_id ?? null,
        drawing_id: drawingId || null,
        issued_on: issuedOn,
        effective_on: effectiveOn || null,
        label_ref: labelRef.trim() || null,
        status: status as never,
        notes: notes.trim() || null,
        add_item: !linkedCode && addItem,
        /* 새로 만들 때만 품목 칸을 보낸다, 이미 있는 품목은 식별·추적성에서 고친다 */
        item:
          !linkedCode && addItem && !sameCodeItem
            ? {
                name: itemInfo.name.trim() || null,
                unit: itemInfo.unit.trim() || null,
                process_step: (itemInfo.processStep || null) as never,
                lot_prefix: itemInfo.lotPrefix.trim() || null,
                status: itemInfo.status as "active" | "obsolete",
                dimension_specs: dimsForSave(itemDims),
                material: itemInfo.material.trim() || null,
                final_product: itemInfo.finalProduct.trim() || null,
                notes: itemInfo.notes.trim() || null,
              }
            : null,
      }
